lines: You could get lost standing still.
I have seen wrong turns with more sense than that.
Careful. Even parchment looks softer than your manners right now.
I have seen broken cartography with better instincts than you.
You could get lost in a fenced garden.
I have seen blank parchment with clearer purpose.
Your thoughts wander without even bringing a map.
That idea has no road, no bridge, and very little hope.
I would mark your sense, but the ink deserves better.
You have the confidence of a shortcut through a swamp.
Even a torn map knows when it is missing something.
Your plan has the shape of a road nobody maintains.
I have seen wrong turns with more dignity.
You are a landmark for poor decisions.
That remark went nowhere and still took the long way.
A compass near you would spin from embarrassment.
You make a dead end feel ambitious.
If confusion needed a guide, it would ask you.
